articles.title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable
articles.description: This week two conversations about AI safety went viral that demonstrate just how hard it is to discern AI fact from fiction.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
articles.description: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
articles.description: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
articles.description: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
articles.description: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
articles.description: The group won't be given leeway to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people’s data to the web
articles.description: The findings highlight how AI-generated and vibe-coded apps can spill and expose users' data when not configured or secured properly.
articles.author: Zack Whittaker

articles.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
articles.description: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said the company's new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
articles.description: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta, Zack Whittaker

articles.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
articles.description: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.
articles.author: Russell Brandom
